name: orrery
description: Long-term memory for Claude from a local markdown vault.
long_description: Orrery keeps your memory as plain markdown notes (Obsidian-compatible). Claude reads a small brief, recalls facts on demand and saves new ones, all within a token budget. Nothing leaves your computer.

tools.name: get_brief
tools.description: Compact memory brief; call once per chat

tools.name: recall
tools.description: One-call answer from memory within a token budget

tools.name: explore
tools.description: Connect related notes and suggest missing links

tools.name: edit_note
tools.description: Append to or replace part of a note

tools.name: update_note
tools.description: Rewrite a note body, keeping frontmatter

tools.name: link_notes
tools.description: Add a wikilink between two notes

vault.title: Vault folder
vault.description: The Orrery (or Obsidian) folder Claude uses as memory.
